## Type of Change

## Checklist

- [ ] My branch follows the naming convention (`feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `cd backend && npm install && npm start` runs cleanly with my changes
- [ ] `cd backend && npm test` passes (or I added tests if none existed for the code I touched)
- [ ] I manually exercised any frontend-visible change in a browser
- [ ] I updated relevant docs (`README.md`, `API_DOCUMENTATION.md`, `TECHNICAL_SUMMARY.md`) if behavior/routes/env vars changed
- [ ] I self-reviewed my diff before requesting review
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or credentials are included in this diff
